title: Magic, Madness, Heaven, Sin: LLM Output Diversity is Everything, Everywhere, All at Once

bias_targets.methodology: The paper conceptually evaluates this bias through literature synthesis, analyzing it as a form of output homogeneity that manifests as either 'erasure' (statistical invisibility of marginalized groups like non-binary or transgender identities in underspecified prompts) or 'stereotyping' (propagation of reductive generalizations and rigid identity-role associations).

The paper evaluates cultural bias conceptually by synthesizing studies that show systemic model convergence toward Anglocentric identities and values, skewed performance on Western vs. non-Western topics, and the systemic underrepresentation of low-resource languages and dialects.

Evaluated through a literature review showing how model outputs homogenize around WEIRD (Western, Educated, Industrialized, Rich, Democratic) value systems, systematically aligning with US norms, English-speaking Protestant European countries, and specific political ideologies.
